footprint_target_cm.source: BP_PickupXP PickupMesh /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube (100 cm) x scale 0.3; big block scale 1.8 (root 0.54) applied in game, not baked

warnings: M_XPChipBig_core_bright and _dark are emissive in Blender (strength 4, #FF26BF and #B0107F): the FBX does not carry emission, the Unreal material sets the glow (MI_PickupXPBig)

C1.evidence: same as run 2, untouched: slab 30 x 30 x 3.4 cm (11 %), four tiles. Differs: source seams thinner and flush.

C2.evidence: Casing 18 cm (60 %), 4.5 cm high (15 %), 45 degree chamfer on 2.0 of 4.5 cm. Chamfer is #585E69 against the wall #3C4048 (about 45 % lighter luminance); in the render the chamfer faces are clearly lighter than the dark vertical wall at the base. A 0.3 cm light band (#A9B0BA) runs along the chamfer top edge and a 0.4 cm light rim around the opening, visible as a thin bright outline. Differs: the 4 corner notches are small and hard to read at this scale, source notches are crisper triangles; the chamfer reads a little lighter and flatter than the source.

C3.evidence: Gem 11.8 cm wide (39 %), stepped faceted (slope, vertical step, slope, flat top), top 2.7 cm above the rim (rim at 7.9, top 10.6); opening 0.9 cm deep; slope facets alternate #FF26BF and #B0107F by orientation with flat shading, so 3 tones are visible in the render (bright, dark, mid). Differs: the source gem is flatter and sits flush in its opening; ours stands taller by design (owner request).

C4.evidence: same as run 2, untouched: 6 identical legs, rounded elbow, flat feet. Differs: source legs chunkier.

C5.evidence: same as run 2, untouched: 4 regular hex bolts. Differs: source heads have a small top chamfer.

C6.evidence: same as run 2, untouched: 5 traces, 3 components. Differs: source traces use 45 degree bends.

C7.evidence: Board and casing gunmetal, chamfer lighter gunmetal, legs, bolts, traces and bands light grey, core magenta, no cyan.

C8.evidence: 872 tris (max 1000), 30 x 30 x 10.6 cm, pivot bottom centre, flat shading, UV checks pass.

C9.evidence: Without the source the core reads as a raised faceted crystal standing proud of a sloped casing: its lower facets are fully visible down to the opening floor, no recess wall hides any part, light and dark facets give volume, it does not read as a flat pink square. Differs: the gem is taller and its base sits close to the light rim.
